confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors rest on a few Interlaken and Swiss menu snippets and secondary Numbeo-derived figures (Basel and Zurich, with Zurich costing more), so they are bounded estimates, not a survey. Main-course prices came from individual menus, not an aggregate index. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Interlaken's July resort pricing; no accommodation search or live listing was checked. CHF-to-USD conversion for the food anchors assumes roughly 1.25 USD per CHF. FX: the 2026-11-18 observation came from a search snippet that cited the RBA Exchange Rates page; I did not open the page directly, so verify it against the RBA F11 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Swiss alpine resort towns with Interlaken-like menus (Lauterbrunnen, Grindelwald), adjusted with Basel and Zurich Numbeo-derived figures for Swiss drink and meal levels. Accommodation is based on general knowledge of July resort rates in Interlaken.
